fusions.name: Through the Bars
fusions.desc: Jabs the blade out at arm's length for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Oubliette
fusions.desc: Opens the ground under every enemy within 3 tiles and shuts it over them, dealing 14 earth damage and stunning them for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried to the Neck
fusions.desc: Packs earth around every creature within 3 tiles, holding them in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt-Hole
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you drop behind a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
